snippet.title: LIVORA Official Trailer – A Modern Life Simulation Strategy Game
snippet.description:
LIVORA is a modern life simulation strategy game where every choice has a cost — and not every cost is money.

Choose a life, manage pressure, make decisions, and try to build something stable while dealing with rent, work, bills, health, relationships, energy, money, and long-term consequences.

Can you survive the month without losing the life you were trying to build?

Play in browser:
https://livora.shiftthestory.co.uk

LIVORA
Build a life. Survive the cost.

#LIVORA #LifeSimulation #StrategyGame #IndieGame
